German golfer Nicolai Von Dellingshausen leads the BMW Australian PGA Championship at 13-under after round 2. Cam Smith surged into contention with a 64 to reach 9-under — 4 shots back. McKibbin at 10-under. #GolfAustralia

x_posts.text:

stories.title: Cameron Smith's Redemption Arc — Post-LIV Comeback and the Path Back to the PGA Tour

x_posts.label: Post 2A
x_posts.text:
**Window:** 10:30 AM ET
**Character count:** 196

Cameron Smith left the PGA Tour for LIV Golf. LIV collapsed. Now he's back in his home country, 4 shots off the lead at the Australian PGA, chasing a path back to the PGA Tour. What a story. #GolfAustralia

x_posts.label: Post 2B
x_posts.text:
**Window:** 8:30 PM ET
**Character count:** 189

Smith on wanting the PGA Tour: "That's where I want to be now, for sure." A win at the Australian PGA this week could be his ticket. He is very much in contention at 9-under. #GolfAustralia
